title: Membrane-Enriched Preparation of Culture Samples for Mass Spectrometry-Based Proteomics
author: Gwendolyn Gallagher
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdapi2dn
materials: Freeze sample (-80 C), then centrivap to dryness.

steps.title: Resuspend pellets and sonicate
steps.instruction: Resuspend each frozen cell pellet (derived from 4.5 mL pure culture) in 333 µL wash solution, then lyse with a QSonica high‑power sonicator (15 min total, 1 s pulse, amplitude 85%).

steps.title: Centrifuge to remove debris
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 2,500 × g for 8 min to pellet unlysed debris.

steps.title: Add carbonate extraction solution
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a polypropylene micro‑fuge tube and add 830 µL carbonate extraction solution (ensure tubes are compatible with the ultracentrifuge).

steps.title: Shake at 4 °C
steps.instruction: Shake the tubes at 4 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Ultracentrifuge membrane pellets
steps.instruction: Balance the tubes by adding additional carbonate extraction solution as needed, then ultracentrifuge at 115,000 × g for 1 hour to pellet membranes.

steps.title: Separate cytosolic and membrane fractions
steps.instruction: Carefully draw off the supernatant (cytosolic fraction) and retain the pellet (membrane fraction).

steps.title: Dilute cytosolic fraction
steps.instruction: Dilute the cytosolic fraction 1:1 with exchange buffer containing 20 mM DTT; use additional Eppendorf tubes if required.

steps.title: Alkylate cytosolic cysteines
steps.instruction: Add iodoacetamide to a final concentration of 60 nM, protect from light, and incubate at room temperature for 1 hour to alkylate cysteine thiols.

steps.title: Sonicate membrane pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the membrane pellet in 500 µL LDS buffer containing 20 mM DTT and sonicate with QSonica (10 min total, 1 s pulse, amplitude 85%).

steps.title: Heat membrane lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane lysate at 95 °C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Incubate at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane lysate at 37 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Alkylate membrane cysteines
steps.instruction: Add iodoacetamide to 60 nM, keep in the dark, and incubate at room temperature for 1 hour to alkylate membrane cysteine thiols.

steps.title: Load lysate onto filter
steps.instruction: For each fraction, mix 50 µL lysate with 400 µL exchange buffer directly on a filter unit.

steps.title: Concentrate lysate by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filter at 14,000 × g for 10 minutes and discard the filtrate; repeat mixing and centrifugation until the entire lysate is concentrated on the filter.

substeps.instruction: Mix lysate with exchange buffer on filter
Repeat until all lysate is on filter

steps.title: Wash filter with exchange buffer
steps.instruction: Wash the filter three times with 200 µL exchange buffer, each wash followed by centrifugation at 14,000 × g for 10 minutes and discard of filtrate.

steps.title: Wash filter with digestion buffer
steps.instruction: Wash the filter two times with 200 µL digestion buffer, each wash followed by centrifugation at 14,000 × g for 10 minutes and discard of filtrate.

steps.title: Transfer filter to collection tube
steps.instruction: Move the filter unit into a passivated collection tube.

steps.title: Digest membrane fraction
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL digestion buffer and 2 µg chymotrypsin onto the membrane filter, seal with parafilm, and incubate overnight at room temperature; then add 2 µg trypsin, reseal, and incubate a second overnight at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Add chymotrypsin (2 µg) in 100 µL digestion buffer

steps.title: Digest cytosolic fraction
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL digestion buffer and 2 µg trypsin onto the cytosolic filter, seal with parafilm, and incubate overnight at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect filtrate after digestion
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filter at 14,000 × g for 10 minutes and keep the filtrate.

steps.title: Recover peptides with buffer
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL peptide recovery buffer to the retained filtrate, centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 10 minutes and keep the filtrate; repeat this addition and centrifugation once more (total two recoveries).

steps.title: Extract peptides with ethyl acetate
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL ethyl acetate to the combined filtrate and transfer to a LoBind tube.

steps.title: Add TFA and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL trifluoroacetic acid (TFA) and vortex gently.

steps.title: Evaporate ethyl acetate
steps.instruction: Fill each tube nearly to the top with ethyl acetate, sonicate for 10 seconds (low power), centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 10 minutes, then discard the upper organic layer; repeat this extraction two additional times (total three extractions).

substeps.instruction: Add ethyl acetate to fill tube

steps.title: Dry peptides at 60 °C
steps.instruction: Place the uncovered tubes in a dry block set to 60 °C and dry for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare peptides for MS
steps.instruction: Reconstitute dried peptides in 2 % acetonitrile, 0.1 % formic acid for direct mass‑spectrometry analysis or proceed to IPTL labeling.
